notes.title: Gameplay Sneak Peek - Watch Now
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings once more, alchemists![/h2][p]You’ve waited patiently for a closer glimpse of [i]Alkahest[/i], and the time has come.[/p][p]The first Alkahest [u]gameplay clips[/u] are now live! You may behold them upon TikTok, Instagram, or YouTube - whichever scrying-glass best suits you. [/p][p][/p][p][b]👉 Find the links here: [url="https://linktr.ee/alkahest_video"]https://linktr.ee/alkahest_video[/url][/b]  
[i]*Steam’s embedded YouTube player doesn’t support Shorts videos[/i][/p][p][/p][p]More videos will be revealed throughout the week, so follow our channels closely. [/p][p]And fear not - the full gameplay trailer awaits later. 
We look forward to hearing your impressions and joining the discussion of the gameplay revealed![/p]

notes.title: Alkahest Gameplay Sneak Peek Coming 👀
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, alchemists![/h2][p]You’ve waited patiently for a closer glimpse of [i]Alkahest[/i], and the time is nearly at hand.

These will appear on our TikTok, Instagram and YouTube, beginning next week.[/p][p][/p][p][b][i]👉 Find the links here: [url="https://linktr.ee/alkahest_video"]https://linktr.ee/alkahest_video[/url][/i][/b] [/p][p][/p][p]To make the journey even more engaging, the guild has set milestones along the path - follow the game on socials to help reach them. Let us continue this journey together![/p]

notes.title: New Trailer & Community Update
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, alchemists![/h2][p]
We’ve been quiet for a while — and for good reason. Behind the scenes, we’ve been pushing hard on Alkahest, and today we’re excited to share some major news. 

[/p][h2]🎬 New Teaser Trailer is Here[/h2][p]
The new trailer gives you a glimpse at Alkahest’s visceral melee combat and interactive environments in motion. It’s not just [i]what[/i] you fight with. It’s [i]where[/i] you fight.  

And look closely — the careful eye may glimpse what the realm has yet to name.  

[/p][previewyoutube="KjuI_FgJ3NM;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[/p][h2]🤝 Welcoming HypeTrain Digital[/h2][p]
 We’re also proud to announce that Alkahest is now being published by [b]HypeTrain Digital[/b].   

Known for championing bold titles and original IP, they bring a proven track record of global distribution, marketing, and community engagement to the table.  Their support and experience will help us reach a wider audience while staying true to our vision.

[/p][h2]💬 Speak Your Mind — Community Survey [/h2][p]
We’d like to get to know you - our future players - a little better. 

Please complete this survey and tell us about the other games you enjoy: [url="https://forms.gle/FQKnHsddQiChEo3k9"]https://forms.gle/FQKnHsddQiChEo3k9[/url]  

Inside the form, you’ll also get an [u][b]exclusive preview of previously unreleased concept art[/b][/u] for the game!   

Your feedback will help us communicate with you more effectively and could even shape the game's development, including potential Easter eggs and other content. Additionally, we intend to interview some players who complete the survey.

[/p][h2]⚔️ What’s Next? [/h2][p]
This teaser is just the beginning. Later this year, we plan to share with you a full gameplay reveal, including new environments, alchemy, and more.

In the meantime: 

🔹Wishlist Alkahest on Steam

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3016620/Alkahest/"][/dynamiclink]🔹Join the community on Discord : [url="https://discord.gg/wzeS52qYb9"]https://discord.gg/wzeS52qYb9[/url] 

🔹 Share your thoughts — we’d love to hear what you think of the teaser! 

Thanks for your support, 
- The Push On Team[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://optim.tildacdn.one/tild3261-3662-4232-a437-373863663831/-/format/webp/s3v2.png.webp"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://optim.tildacdn.one/tild6535-6165-4230-b833-346538316438/-/format/webp/s2.png.webp"][/img] [/p][p][img src="https://optim.tildacdn.one/tild3831-6133-4264-b832-613238366239/-/format/webp/s1.png.webp"][/img][/p]
